papers.title: Daily and annual modulation rate of low mass dark matter in silicon detectors
papers.summary: Low threshold detectors with single-electron excitation sensitivity to nuclear recoil events in solid-state detectors are also sensitive to the crystalline structure of the target and, therefore, to the recoil direction via the anisotropic energy threshold for defect creation in the detector material.
